Built a complete, playable side-scrolling game in `index.html`. It includes a hand-drawn battlefield, soldier character, enemy encounters, pistol and knife combat, jumpable trenches, pickups, checkpoints, and an extraction objective with win and loss screens.

**Controls:** A/D or arrow keys to move, Space/W to jump, J to fire, K to use the knife, and R to restart. Touch controls are included for mobile.

I assumed a self-contained HTML Canvas game with original, code-drawn artwork rather than external image assets. Verified JavaScript syntax and loaded the game in a browser with no console errors.
